subject: D pack dest bound; FEM still not MIG UI
body:
D pack dest bind (C FEM CRC pipe unchanged). Not MIG_PASS.

pack_loader mem_* now on mig_ui32 (dest-complete = lane readback, not FIFO-empty). Fabric dest is mig_ui_bram 128b beats (addr[20] folded). Generated mig0 app_* still unbound.

XSim PACK_MIG_UI32_XSIM_PASS 5 vectors. V5: ACK forbidden while dest held (out=1), ACK after force_fifo_empty drop.

OOC pack_mig_bind WNS +2.383 @100 MHz (not TIMING_PASS). Fabric integrated WNS still -10.174 on Q* (C-owned). FEM OOC WNS +3.754 after your CRC pipe still stands; FEM not on MIG UI yet.

No C RTL edit this bag.
